Container.Name: H&H Media Guard
Container.Description: Monitor Only audio language verification for Sonarr/Radarr. Supply your app URL, encryption key and media host path. Keep media read-only and destructive actions disabled.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent H&H Media Guard configuration and database. Use a dedicated appdata directory, separate from media.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Media library mounted read-only for Monitor Only scanning. Select your own host media directory.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Protects stored Sonarr/Radarr credentials. Generate once with: openssl rand -base64 32. Preserve the same key across updates and backups.

Config.Name: Destructive Actions
Config.Description: Safety kill-switch. Keep false for Monitor Only mode.

Config.Name: Media Roots
Config.Description: Approved container media root that Media Guard is allowed to scan. Multiple roots use commas.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Use your region/city time zone, such as Europe/London, or keep Etc/UTC. Unraid may supply its host time zone; check the value when adding the container.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Exact browser address: http://SERVER-IP:3938 or https://media.example.com. No path or trailing query.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Optional extra browser origins, comma-separated. APP_URL is always allowed. Leave blank for a simple LAN install; normally the browser uses APP_URL.

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: Non-root runtime user ID. 99 is Unraid nobody. Only application-owned /config entries are ownership-managed; media is never changed.

Config.Name: Group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Runtime group ID. 100 is Unraid users. Must be a non-zero numeric ID.

Config.Name: Suite Name
Config.Description: Initial suite branding name; branding remains customizable in the app.

Config.Name: App Name
Config.Description: Initial application name. The fox favicon/app icon remain builder-managed.
